description.value: Empty Keg Brew House is a family-friendly craft brewery established in May 2019 in Merritt, BC's Nicola Valley, featured on the Southern Interior Ale Trail, with over 67 handcrafted beer varieties created since opening. The brewhouse pairs a rotating tap list of unfiltered ales, lagers, stouts, and hard seltzers with a food menu of burgers, chicken, charcuterie, and pub fare ordered at a self-serve front bar. A recent solar installation and an expanded patio reflect the owners' community-minded ethos in this small-town gathering spot.
